title: MIHVER Local Publication Receipt
description: Machine-readable result of the deterministic Local Publication Builder (scripts/dev/publication-builder.mjs), per V3.1-A. Reports a local commit only -- it never reports a push or a remote PR state, since the builder never performs either. Consumed by Claude for its own report, and is the artifact the future privileged Publication Broker (V3.1-B, not implemented here) will independently re-verify before any remote effect.

commit_sha.description: Required (non-schema-enforced) when status is COMMITTED; absent on BLOCKED.

local_head.description: HEAD after the builder ran -- equals commit_sha on COMMITTED, equals pre_publish_head on BLOCKED (no commit made).

failure_reason.description: Required (non-schema-enforced), exact, machine-readable reason when status is BLOCKED; absent on COMMITTED.
